<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI policy focus:</strong> The Monetary Policy Committee has commenced a three-day meeting, with economists widely anticipating a 25 basis point repo rate hike to address rising inflation and pressure from $100 crude oil prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market sentiment:</strong> Indian indices rebounded strongly, with the Sensex gaining over 700 points and the Nifty rising, supported by positive global cues and banking sector performance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I33</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I34</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Key drivers for volatility:</strong> Investors are closely monitoring the interplay between US Treasury bond yields, global crude oil prices, and the Federal Reserve&#x27;s interest rate outlook, all of which are influencing domestic market liquidity and the rupee.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a></span></li>
</ul>
